name: Harness Self-Test (Echo)

metrics.description: Share of cases for which the harness sent a prompt and stored a non-empty response.

description: A trivial, deterministic suite that exercises the whole run engine end to end. It measures FreeWeight, not the model: a passing result says the queue, scheduler, provider call, sample store, event stream and aggregation all work on this machine. It emits no capability evidence and must never be read as a quality score.
